title: Clean-restart contract (start_run/restart_run/fresh_seed) has zero automated test
detail: Named 1.4 contract 'clean restart' (fresh seed, no leaked score/events/terminal) is app-layer glue. No @(test) exists in app/; run_init zeroing + run_destroy are tested, but the restart orchestration + E32 fresh seed are not.
recommended_fix: Extract start_run/restart_run to a raylib-free helper; add a test: run to terminal, restart, assert score=0, events cleared, terminal=false, and fresh seed differs from the prior.

title: App Mode FSM (Boot/Run/Game_Over transitions) has no automated test
detail: Only the driving core flags (state.terminal/outcome) are unit-tested. The app FSM transitions — Run->Game_Over on mid-catch-up terminal, Game_Over->Run on R/Enter — are untested. Acceptable for a stub, but an honest gap.
recommended_fix: Unit-test the mode decision logic (mode <-> terminal/outcome) in isolation, decoupled from raylib input/render, to pin the FSM transitions.

title: Replay byte-identical pinned for the WIN loop only; LOSE terminal frame is golden-only
detail: Contract (f) is unit-pinned for the WIN loop only. The LOSE loop's terminal frame + frozen post-terminal ticks are covered solely by the harness golden lose.t1 (ticks 61-64 identical cb0220c15bd0e883), not by any core test.
recommended_fix: Add test_lose_loop_replay_byte_identical mirroring the WIN test: incomplete graph + tick_cap, assert live==replay hash sequence including the frozen tail.

title: Degenerate 'spawned at own dst' score increment (flow.odin:151) is untested
detail: The second state.score += 1 (a packet spawned at its own dst scores) is a 1.4 behavior change. No test seeds a self-dst spawn; only the normal delivery score (line 142) is exercised by test_win_on_goal_reached.
recommended_fix: Add a test spawning a packet whose src==dst (or arrives at spawn) and assert state.score increments and Run_Won fires when goal is met.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
Finished 27 tests in 4.436ms. All tests were successful.
--- @(test) in app/ or harness/: (none)
detail: P0 core sim contracts fully covered (WIN/LOSE/barrier/tie/disable/cap-only = 100%, 7 crisp tests; WIN terminal-frame replay pinned). Overall ~85%. CONCERNS: named 'clean restart' contract has zero automated coverage (app-layer) and LOSE-loop replay is golden-only. Harness integration (5/5 demos, 29/29 drift) mitigates but is not unit coverage.
recommended_fix: (1) extract+test start_run/restart_run for clean-restart; (2) add LOSE-loop replay-byte-identical; (3) add self-delivery score test. Raises gate to PASS.
